profile.summary: KEB Berhad, through its subsidiary, engages in the property development business in Malaysia. The company focuses on the development and sales of residential, industrial, commercial, and mixed-use development properties. The company was incorporated in 2023 and is based in Cheras, Malaysia.
profile.zh: KEB Berhad 通过其子公司，在马来西亚从事房地产开发业务。公司成立于2023年，总部位于马来西亚Cheras。
lines: 房地产开发与销售：开发和销售住宅、工业、商业及混合用途开发物业，客户为马来西亚的购房者和企业。
lines_en: Property development and sales: develops and sells residential, industrial, commercial, and mixed-use development properties to homebuyers and businesses in Malaysia.
